basis: Android build 54 code and SDK dependency metadata, reviewed 2026-09-13

dataTypes.basis: Optional onboarding/profile display name and personalized email greeting.
Firebase email/password or federated login, account messages, opted-in marketing.
Firebase UID, RevenueCat appUserID, linked telemetry and consent preferences.
RevenueCat and Play subscriptions, entitlement and purchase lifecycle.
Optional body weight, body measurements, goals and Health Connect weight import.
Primary workout history, sets, weight, reps, training profile and suggestions.
Optional avatar, progress photos and support screenshots.

Conservative disclosure: avatar upload preserves original file bytes and may retain EXIF GPS from a user-supplied file. No GPS permission or active location tracking. This is a source-code inference, not a finding in real user photos.
User-initiated workout/history email, recipient, subject and HTML retained in email_log.
Optional workout notes, custom plan labels and support requests.
Screen/event counters and email open/click telemetry, including opted-in marketing messages.
Global JS errors, rejected promises and stack context in client_errors.
Technical error codes, sync context and platform/version diagnostics; SDK integrity metadata. No Firebase Performance SDK.
Firebase installations, push tokens, per-installation push ID, attestation and IP security logs. No advertising ID collection configured.

excluded: Phone number: no phone authentication or SMS MFA
Approximate location: IP logs are used as security identifiers, no app geolocation inference; RevenueCat documents locale/currency only
Financial payment details: handled by Google Play, never provided to app
No contacts, calendar read, microphone, user video collection, search history, installed-app inventory or browsing history found
templateExtension: Current account/deletion fields absent from Google public sample; identifiers checked against primary Fastlane plugin source and Google API validation.
